answers.core: As mentioned above, this cannot be achieved without changes to the core.
answers.workaround:
Unfortunately, that’s not feasible. I attempted to implement this using `EditorExportPlugin`, but due to the unresolved dependency issues, it required extremely cumbersome manual parsing to make it work. This should be a core functionality of the engine.
We shouldn’t expect users to manually parse scripts or scenes to identify all dependencies.
